meta.name: Un mundo diferente
meta.description: Una nueva clase entra en el campus del Hillman College y caras muy queridas vuelven a casa. En el centro está Deborah Wayne, la cariñosamente protegida hija menor de Whitley y Dwayne, un espíritu libre con un don para ser el centro de atención y un gran corazón que todavía está descubriendo su propio camino en Hillman. Por el camino, se le une una nueva generación que refleja la amplitud de la vida negra en el campus: Rashida Duvall, una estudiante de justicia criminal de primera generación; Shaquille Johnson, un atleta de cinco estrellas que elige su legado; Amir Rodale, un avispado estudiante de psicología más dado a arreglar los problemas de los demás que a enfrentarse a los suyos propios; Hazel Henry, una chica de pueblo criada en la iglesia que define sus propios valores; y Kojo Achebe, un empresario de la moda ghanés-nigeriano que encuentra el valor para seguir su visión.

videos.title: Irreconcilable Differences
videos.overview: Deborah Wayne continues her parents' legacy by enrolling at Hillman College, where a new roommate and an old flame instantly complicate the situation.

videos.title: O Captain! My Captain!
videos.overview: Deborah gets put on blast for speaking her mind. Rashida hustles to make extra cash. Shaquille's first football game doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Center de Stage
videos.overview: As old friends arrive for homecoming weekend, Dwayne and Whitley navigate marital tensions, while Deborah scrambles to lock down a headliner.

videos.title: Those Who Can... Cuff
videos.overview: Cuffing season at Hillman is heating up, but school stress, money trouble and date-night drama could put the whole vibe on ice.

videos.title: Final Words
videos.overview: Finals are kicking off and the entire crew is pressed — until a crisis makes them rethink what really matters.

videos.title: Insomnia and the Daydreamer
videos.overview: Deborah questions whether she's found the man of her dreams. A night at the club gets messy when the aunties pull up.

videos.title: Sometimes You Get The Culture... Sometimes The Culture Gets You
videos.overview: At the school talent show, Deborah and Kojo set out to prove their doubters wrong. Hazel finally competes for the title of Miss Gilbert Hall.

videos.title: I Choose Chaos
videos.overview: Stuck inside during a tornado warning, Hazel and Amir can't dodge their beef any longer. Deborah and Shaquille open up about their original breakup.

videos.title: Romancing the Unknown
videos.overview: When Hillman's budget crisis — and the conflict between Dwayne and Whitley — pops off, Deborah and her friends make their move.

videos.title: A Gift & the Curse
videos.overview: The end-of-year gala brings big decisions, big drama and a new chapter in Hillman's story.
